# Objective

- Rename the `render::primitives::Plane` struct as to not confuse it with `bevy_render::mesh::shape::Plane`
- Fixes https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/8730

## Solution

- Refactor the `render::primitives::Plane` struct to `render::primitives::HalfSpace`
- Modify documentation to reflect this change

## Changelog

- Renamed `render::primitives::Plane` to `render::primitives::HalfSpace` to more accurately represent it's use
- Renamed `planes` member in `render::primitives::Frustum` to `half_spaces` to reflect changes

## Migration Guide

- Change instances of `render::primitives::Plane` to `render::primitives::HalfSpace`
- Change instances of the `planes` member in `render::primitives::Frustum` to `half_spaces`

issue_context.title: `render::primitive::Plane` is confusing
issue_context.body:
## How can Bevy's documentation be improved?

[`render::primitive::Plane`](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/4ce37395da029eb8b58c78c32812fe8329a3a1a4/crates/bevy_render/src/primitives/mod.rs#L84-L91) is used mostly for frustum culling.

It is used as a half-space (discriminate between two sides of a plane in 3d space) to find which sector of a frustum we are in , and I think it should be renamed to `HalfSpace`, especially given we already have a `shape::Plane` that has nothing to do with it.

review_comments: I see the doc string for `Frustrum` mention planes. Could you reword it as well?
Props to you, I like the phrasing :+1:
